capabilities: Load TTF, OTF, WOFF, and WOFF2 font files from a vault folder
Assign fonts separately to UI, body text, code, and math
Use different fonts for Latin and CJK characters via unicode-range
Detect and group font variants like Regular, Italic, Bold, and Bold Italic
Assign cross-device font presets per device
extras: The README includes a performance warning: dense mixing of many languages in one line can freeze the rendering engine. It works fully offline with no telemetry, and reads limited device information (hostname, mobile device identifier, app language) only to distinguish devices in the cross-device preset list. Requires Obsidian v1.13.0 or higher per the English requirements section (other language sections say v1.0.0).
intentEvidence: Say goodbye to relying on external CDNs or system fonts — keep everything local
problem: Obsidian's built-in font options depend on system fonts or external CDNs and cannot use font files stored in the vault or distinguish Latin and CJK characters.
summary: Font loader that loads TTF, OTF, WOFF, and WOFF2 fonts from vault files and applies them separately to UI, body text, code, and math.
